name: Line Item 10
definition: Unit of information showing the related provision of products and/or services and monetary summations reported as a discrete line items.

Identification.name: Identification
Identification.definition: The unique identification of this invoice line item.

TradeProduct.name: Trade Product
TradeProduct.definition: Something that is produced and sold as the result of an industrial process.

BuyerOrderIdentification.name: Buyer Order Identification
BuyerOrderIdentification.definition: Purchase order reference assigned by the buyer related to the provision of products and/or services for this line item.

ContractIdentification.name: Contract Identification
ContractIdentification.definition: Contract reference related to the provision of products and/or services for this line item.

PurchaseAccountingAccount.name: Purchase Accounting Account
PurchaseAccountingAccount.definition: Specific purchase account for recording debits and credits for accounting purposes.

NetPrice.name: Net Price
NetPrice.definition: Value of the price, eg, as a currency and value.

NetPriceQuantity.name: Net Price Quantity
NetPriceQuantity.definition: Quantity and conversion factor on which the net price is based for this line item product and/or service.

NetPriceAllowanceCharge.name: Net Price Allowance Charge
NetPriceAllowanceCharge.definition: Allowance or charge applied to the net price.

GrossPrice.name: Gross Price
GrossPrice.definition: Gross price of the product and/or service.

GrossPriceQuantity.name: Gross Price Quantity
GrossPriceQuantity.definition: Quantity and conversion factor on which the gross price is based for this line item product and/or service.

LogisticsCharge.name: Logistics Charge
LogisticsCharge.definition: Logistics service charge for this line item.

Tax.name: Tax
Tax.definition: Amount of money due to the government or tax authority, according to various pre-defined parameters such as thresholds or income.

AllowanceCharge.name: Allowance Charge
AllowanceCharge.definition: Allowance or charge specified for this line item.

FinancialAdjustment.name: Financial Adjustment
FinancialAdjustment.definition: Modification on the value of goods and / or services. For example: rebate, discount, surcharge.

BilledQuantity.name: Billed Quantity
BilledQuantity.definition: Quantity billed for this line item.

PerPackageUnitQuantity.name: Per Package Unit Quantity
PerPackageUnitQuantity.definition: Number of units per package in this line item for a supply chain trade delivery.

ChargeFreeQuantity.name: Charge Free Quantity
ChargeFreeQuantity.definition: Quantity that is free of charge for this line item.

MeasureQuantityStart.name: Measure Quantity Start
MeasureQuantityStart.definition: Quantity value on which the quantity measurement started for a line item. For instance the start amount of a meter reading for an electricity supplier.

MeasureQuantityEnd.name: Measure Quantity End
MeasureQuantityEnd.definition: Quantity value on which the quantity measurement ended for a line item. For instance the end amount of a meter reading for an electricity supplier.

MeasureDateTimeStart.name: Measure Date Time Start
MeasureDateTimeStart.definition: Date/time on which the clock time measure started for a line item.

MeasureDateTimeEnd.name: Measure Date Time End
MeasureDateTimeEnd.definition: Date/time on which the clock time measure ended for a line item.

ShipTo.name: Ship To
ShipTo.definition: Party to whom the goods must be delivered in the end.

Incoterms.name: Incoterms
Incoterms.definition: Specifies the applicable Incoterm and associated location.

DeliveryDateTime.name: Delivery Date Time
DeliveryDateTime.definition: Actual delivery date/time of the products and/or services for this line item.

DeliveryNoteIdentification.name: Delivery Note Identification
DeliveryNoteIdentification.definition: Delivery note related to the delivery of the products and/or services for this line item.

MonetarySummation.name: Monetary Summation
MonetarySummation.definition: Monetary totals for this line item.

IncludedNote.name: Included Note
IncludedNote.definition: Note included in this line item.
